title: Weak or Outdated TLS/SSL Configuration

references.name: OWASP - Transport Layer Security Cheat Sheet

description: The service supports deprecated protocol versions (SSLv3, TLS 1.0/1.1), weak cipher suites, or uses an invalid, expired, or self-signed certificate. These weaknesses can enable downgrade and adversary-in-the-middle attacks or undermine trust in the endpoint.
businessImpact: Moderate --- weak transport security can permit interception or tampering under certain conditions and erodes assurance of confidentiality and integrity.
remediation:
- Disable SSLv2/SSLv3 and TLS 1.0/1.1; support only TLS 1.2 and 1.3.
- Enable only strong cipher suites with forward secrecy and disable weak/export ciphers.
- Use valid, trusted certificates with appropriate key sizes and timely renewal.
- Enable HSTS and test configuration regularly.
